name: NemakiWare - governance simulate burst
description: More than ${BURST_THRESHOLD:-20} externalGovernanceSimulate events from one actor in 5 minutes. A human admin can't realistically click through this many what-if simulations — either legitimate automation (deploy under a service account with its own monitoring) or an exploration attack. Playbook: docs/SOC-AUDIT-INTEGRATION.md §5.1

name: NemakiWare - lost-count outlier
description: externalGovernanceSimulate with details.lostCount > ${LOST_COUNT_OUTLIER_THRESHOLD:-50}. Sweeping change pre-flight — review before any subsequent externalProfileUpdated or connector PUT by the same actor. Playbook: docs/SOC-AUDIT-INTEGRATION.md §5.2

name: NemakiWare - simulate-then-act (EQL sequence)
description: externalGovernanceSimulate by actor A followed within 30m by externalProfileUpdated or externalProfileDeleted by the same actor in the same repository. The deliberate-change signal. Not inherently bad — but elevated visibility helps after-action review. Playbook: docs/SOC-AUDIT-INTEGRATION.md §5.3
query: sequence by userId.keyword,repositoryId.keyword with maxspan=30m [ any where operation == "externalGovernanceSimulate" ] [ any where operation == "externalProfileUpdated" or operation == "externalProfileDeleted" ]

name: NemakiWare - off-hours simulate (requires shipper-side hour enrichment)
description: externalGovernanceSimulate emitted outside business hours. Detection Engine KQL has no native time-of-day filter, so this rule expects an `hour_of_day_local` integer field added by the shipper. The provided fluent-bit / vector templates show the enrichment processor; for Filebeat use a processors.script step. If you do not add the enrichment, this rule will never fire — use a Watcher (PUT _watcher/watch/nemakiware-off-hours-simulate, body in the README) instead. Playbook: docs/SOC-AUDIT-INTEGRATION.md §5.4
query: operation: "externalGovernanceSimulate" AND (hour_of_day_local < 6 OR hour_of_day_local >= 22 OR day_of_week_local: ("Saturday" OR "Sunday"))

name: NemakiWare - new-actor first-time invoker (new_terms)
description: Detects a userId that emitted externalGovernanceSimulate in the current window but did NOT appear in the 90-day lookback. Expected for rotation / new hire, but worth one human-look confirmation. Uses Detection Engine's new_terms rule type, which is purpose-built for this lookback. Playbook: docs/SOC-AUDIT-INTEGRATION.md §5.5
